title: Equipped block skin applies to locked blocks
statement: The equipped block skin, selected via the equipped_block storage key, is applied by the board renderer to locked board cells so settled blocks use the same colors/gradients as the active falling piece, keeping the look consistent before and after landing.
aliases: 落地方块皮肤与下落方块一致
已装备方块皮肤应用到锁定方块
settled blocks use equipped block skin
